source: Master Audience Recorded By Steve Hill, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM100/CP4 Shotguns > Sony D5, Tapes: Maxell UDXLLII 90's; Tapes Labelled: Master-Nakamichi 100 Guns - Sandy; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion/Flacked With AudioGate V.3.02 To 24 Bit/96 kHz; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Decent recording of a long show that feels a bit choppy, with no standout moments highlighted.
ai_review.review: The tape sounds solid and the set runs long, but reviewers note the performance is somewhat uneven and “choppy” in places. No particular songs or jams are singled out as highlights, making this a respectable but unremarkable entry in the Dead’s catalog.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate (3‑star) review; reviewer praises the recording (“good spin”) but criticizes the playing as choppy, yielding an average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the spin as good and does not mention audio flaws, implying a clear, listenable source despite lack of detail on source type.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long set but described as choppy in its playing; no specific highlights or low points noted.
